description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the list of regions supported by Wuying Cloud Desktop.

description.zh: 资源ID列表，即云电脑ID列表。可包含1\~50个。
description.en: The list of resource IDs, that is, the list of cloud desktop IDs. You can specify 1 to 50 resource IDs.
The list of tags. You can specify 1 to 20 tags.

description.zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag key. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. The value can be an empty string. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

descriptions.zh: 如果设置的标签键（TagKey）已存在，则新设置的TagValue将覆盖原有TagValue。
descriptions.en: If the specified TagKey already exists, the new TagValue overwrites the original TagValue.
